name: Start here — edition, navigation and reliability
text:
### Start here — edition, navigation and reliability

**ID:** `guide-usage` · **Type:** guide · **Section:** Getting started / Start here


#### Scope

This is a consolidated reference for the **original English PlayStation Final Fantasy Tactics**, built from all six supplied guides. It is a replacement reference to their substantive gameplay, data, dialogue and lore, not a replacement for the game or an independently tested remake guide. Full story spoilers follow.

The detailed mechanical reference takes priority over simplified walkthrough claims, except where an explicit correction says otherwise. Tactical recommendations and ratings are attributed opinions. Different numeric datasets, alternate boss/unit IDs, dialogue branches and same-name rare items are preserved as distinct records. A blank or “Varies” is missing source data, not zero.

Modern-edition guard: Square Enix describes Ivalice Chronicles Enhanced as mechanically adjusted, and Classic as original graphics/gameplay with the War of the Lions translation. That does not certify every PSX value against either newer mode. [E01](#web-e01).


#### How to find an answer

Use the section index or search for a name, job, location, formula symbol, original bracket code or stable ID. Every record has an explicit anchor, category and provenance. A reference link replaces a duplicate, not the underlying information. Maps retain monospaced coordinate grids because whitespace carries meaning. Their original orientation must be used; coordinates from differently oriented guides are not interchangeable.

For an AI reader: retrieve the edition and errata records first, then the named entity and its related records. Cite the source ID and physical line range. Prefer a stated formula to a prose approximation. Do not treat story dialogue, dramatic stage directions, ratings, historical fan projects, uncertain reports or blank table cells as verified mechanics. Interpret arithmetic brackets as integer truncation toward zero unless the source explicitly says round up. Source and research dates are separate.


#### What was removed

GameFAQs navigation, repeated contents lists, ASCII title logos, obsolete contact policies, duplicated numeric tables and exact repeated long blocks have been replaced by structured navigation and references. Original author attribution and usage notices remain. Source-specific alternate values and opinions are retained, but separated from the canonical lookup fields. Some paraphrased contextual overlap remains where eliminating it would destroy a self-contained tactic or attribution.


#### Using the companion dashboard

Open FFT_Dashboard_Guide.html in a modern browser. Its full guide data, styling and scripts are embedded; external research links are optional. Search covers complete record text, not just titles. Use quotation marks for a phrase, then narrow by subject or group. Ctrl/Cmd+K focuses search. Record pages provide related entries, source provenance, copying, printing and bookmarks. Stat tables can be filtered by level without changing the master data.

The checklist and bookmarks use browser-local storage where available. They are personal reading/planning state, not imported game-save data, and do not synchronize between devices. Private browsing, file-access policy or storage restrictions may limit persistence; the dashboard displays a warning and keeps session state instead. The Story/Lore filter is not a universal spoiler shield: campaign, item, class and quest entries may reveal later content.

The Markdown button decompresses the embedded, byte-identical master .md file in browsers supporting DecompressionStream. The separately supplied .md remains the fallback. Copy link produces a local-file or current-page URL, not a publicly hosted website. Original source usage notices apply; this compilation has not been publicly published.

Dashboard QA used an in-memory Chromium render because this environment blocks local-file and local-URL browser navigation. Search, record routing, table filtering, menu behavior, themes and session state were exercised at desktop and mobile sizes. Cross-reload storage persistence and native file downloads could not be directly verified under that browser policy.

name: A practical route into the reference
text:
### A practical route into the reference

**ID:** `quick-start` · **Type:** guide · **Section:** Getting started / Start here


#### Before advancing

Maintain a world-map save outside a multi-battle location, especially before Riovanes and the final Orbonne sequence. Teach and equip abilities explicitly; learning an off-job skill does not automatically put it in an active slot. Keep recovery and revival available to more than one unit. Follow the battle record’s objective: a boss-target battle can end before you have collected optional items.

For the original guided party route, the source assumes Ramza’s birthday is January 1 and gives the sample names Zach, Annette and Laura to chosen generics. These are plan labels, not mandatory story recruits. The general tactical section remains usable without following that build. [W:170–185](#source-w); [W:353–358](#source-w); [W:669–684](#source-w).


#### Choose a reference path

**Campaign:** ordered battle plans, deployments, enemy notes and between-battle shopping.

**Jobs → Abilities → Mechanics:** unlocks, carrier/class data, individual effects, then exact formulas and timing.

**Equipment → Quests → Maps:** item properties, acquisition routes, poaching, and the coordinate source.

**Bestiary → Statistics:** monster capabilities plus explicitly separate level datasets.

**Story → Lore:** full supplied script, branches, Scriptures, biographies, job reports, treasures and discoveries.

**Verification:** corrections, unresolved fields and evidence limitations. Read this before relying on a contested number.

### Completion planning — irreversible-risk checklist

**ID:** `completion-checklist` · **Type:** checklist · **Section:** Getting started / Planning


#### Player checklist

- [ ] Keep a world-map recovery save before chained battles. See [Orbonne Monastery — prologue and controls](#campaign-prologue).
- [ ] Retain Mustadio for the optional recruitment chain. See [Secret characters — original recruitment route](#recruitment-chain).
- [ ] Buy the flower at Zarghidas before completing the Cloud route. See [Secret characters — original recruitment route](#recruitment-chain).
- [ ] Prepare Ramza for the Riovanes duel before the inside save. See [Riovanes Castle II](#battle-2-3j).
- [ ] Finish intended Genji/Masamune theft during the PSX Limberry interior encounter. See [Zodiac monsters — battle-specific profiles](#boss-compendium).
- [ ] Collect the rare Javelin and Escutcheon before finishing Nelveska. See [Nelveska Temple — Worker 7 New](#optional-nelveska).
- [ ] Retrieve Materia Blade for Cloud’s Limit command. See [Secret characters — original recruitment route](#recruitment-chain).
- [ ] Bring a Summoner able to survive Zodiac before ending the Elidibs fight. See [Deep Dungeon — exploration rules](#deep-dungeon).
- [ ] Finish optional exploration before the final point-of-no-return route. See [Deep Dungeon — exploration rules](#deep-dungeon).


#### Scope of this checklist

This is a planning aid, not a claim that every optional item is permanently missable. Item records distinguish one-time map pickups from repeatable poaching, catches or other sources. The checklist tracks your manual progress locally in the dashboard; it does not inspect game saves.

name: How do Males and Females Differ?
text:
### How do Males and Females Differ?

**ID:** `faq-how-do-males-and-females-differ` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:202-213](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

Every generic unit starts with two available classes: Squire and Chemist. Getting enough Job Points (JP) as a Squire unlocks certain jobs and getting enough JP as a Chemist unlocks other jobs. The jobs that Squire unlocks tend to be more physical and the jobs that being a Chemist unlocks are mainly magical. Females naturally have a better Magic Attack stat and more MP while Males naturally have a better Physical Attack stat and more HP. Generally males are better at the jobs Squire unlocks and Females are better at the jobs being a Chemist unlocks. Good Faith is also very important in being effective at the jobs Chemist unlocks.

*Source: [W:202-213](#source-w)*

name: How does the battle flow and what are CT, Clockticks and CTR?
text:
### How does the battle flow and what are CT, Clockticks and CTR?

**ID:** `faq-how-does-the-battle-flow-and-what-are-ct-clockticks-and-ctr` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:298-317](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

CT is a very prominent stat listed below HP and MP in battle. When a unit reaches 100 CT they get a turn. So what determines CT? Speed and Clockticks. The Speed stat can be found in the status menu, a Clocktick is far more nebulous. A Clocktick is the Final Fantasy Tactics measure of time but cannot be measured in a standard way. Basically every Clocktick, every unit gains Speed points to their CT. If a unit has 10 Speed, after 1 clocktick they have 10 CT. After 10 Clockticks they have 100 CT and get a turn.

CTR is shorthand for Clockticks 'til resolution. That stat tells you how long it takes for a spell to resolve. If a spell has 2 CTR then it takes two clockticks for the spell to resolve. CTR is determined by dividing 100 by the speed number found in the ability menus. If a spell has higher speed then it has a lower CTR and thus resolves faster.

For a better explanation of all this, read "Aaditya Rangan's Theory of Gameflow" section located in Aerostar's Battle Mechanics Guide:

http://www.fftactics.net/fftmech/fftmech52.txt

*Source: [W:298-317](#source-w)*

name: How many saves should I have?
text:
### How many saves should I have?

**ID:** `faq-how-many-saves-should-i-have` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:168-174](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

Often the game will let you save in a place that you cannot leave until you beat the battle. However sometimes you are not strong enough to beat the level and the game will not let you leave. Make sure you have multiple save files so you do not get trapped in any unbeatable predicaments.

*Source: [W:168-174](#source-w)*

name: What do Brave and Faith do?
text:
### What do Brave and Faith do?

**ID:** `faq-what-do-brave-and-faith-do` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:188-201](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

Brave affects how often your reaction abilities trigger and how much damage you deal with your fists. Reaction abilities trigger Brave % of the time. Fist damage is [Brave*Physical Attack]*Physical Attack. If your Brave goes below 10 you turn into a chicken.

Faith determines how much damage your spells deal and how often your spells succeed. Higher Faith means more damage and a higher success rate for your spells. High Faith also means you take more magic damage and are more vulnerable to enemy spells.

Check out section ten for more Brave and Faith information.

*Source: [W:188-201](#source-w)*

name: What is PA, MA, and Speed and what do they do?
text:
### What is PA, MA, and Speed and what do they do?

**ID:** `faq-what-is-pa-ma-and-speed-and-what-do-they-do` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:214-231](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

PA is your physical attack stat, MA is your magical attack stat, and Speed determines how often your character gets a turn. Greater PA makes your attacks stronger and greater MA makes your spells stronger.

Unlike most Final Fantasy games, leveling up does very little to increase your stats until you get that coveted Speed, PA, or MA point. MA and PA increase differently in different classes. Some classes have naturally high MA (Wizard) and naturally high PA (Knight). For average Speed Growth you can get Speed Points at these levels:

Level 18 - 7 Speed Level 35 - 8 Speed Level 52 - 9 Speed Level 69 - 10 Speed Level 86 - 11 Speed

*Source: [W:214-231](#source-w)*

name: What is the AT Menu? How can I tell who gets to go when?
text:
### What is the AT Menu? How can I tell who gets to go when?

**ID:** `faq-what-is-the-at-menu-how-can-i-tell-who-gets-to-go-when` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:289-297](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

During battle, before hitting circle to select which action you are going to do press right. That brings up the AT menu and tells you if you select that action when the action is going to be performed. This is useful for magic spells since they do not occur instantly. Check the AT to make sure the spell will resolve before the unit you are targeting gets a chance to move out of the way. The AT menu can also be brought up by hitting triangle during battle.

*Source: [W:289-297](#source-w)*

name: What's the deal with abilities?
text:
### What's the deal with abilities?

**ID:** `faq-what-s-the-deal-with-abilities` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:175-187](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

Every human unit has five different ability slots: Primary, Secondary, Reaction, Support, and Movement. The primary slot is determined by what job your character has. The rest of the abilities must be equipped. Secondary skill sets can be any primary from a another class. For example a Squire always has Basic Skill as a primary, but for another class to use a Basic Skill ability in battle they need to have it equipped as their secondary. Reaction abilities trigger in response to different actions performed on a unit and include things like Counter and Auto Potion. Support abilities allow you to equip different equipment or strengthen your stats. Movement abilities increase your movement range or give you a movement bonus like Move HP-Up.

*Source: [W:175-187](#source-w)*

name: What's the deal with evasion?
text:
### What's the deal with evasion?

**ID:** `faq-what-s-the-deal-with-evasion` · **Type:** faq · **Section:** Getting started / Original FAQ

**Provenance:** [W:161-167](#source-w)


#### Player-facing explanation

Every character has natural physical evasion that makes it harder to hit them when attacking their front. Shields add evasion when units are attacked from the front or the sides. Basically try to attack people from the back or the sides to have a higher chance of succeeding with your attack.

*Source: [W:161-167](#source-w)*

name: Chapter 1 — preparation and battle index
text:
### Chapter 1 — preparation and battle index

**ID:** `campaign-chapter-1` · **Type:** chapter · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Provenance:** [W:435-467](#source-w)


#### Chapter guidance

##### Control + F

Gariland [2.1a] Mandalia Plains [2.1b] Sweegy Woods [2.1c] Dorter Trade City [2.1d] Sand Rat Cellar [2.1e] Thieves Fort [2.1f] Lenalia Plateau [2.1g] Fovoham Plains Windmill Shed [2.1h] Fort Zeakden [2.1i]

||| Strategies |||

/ Operate as a Team \

Have your units actions be coordinated. Try to gang up on specific enemies and eliminate them one at a time. Dealing fatal damage to one unit is a much more effective way of winning the battle than hurting each enemy unit a little.

/ Bring Healing \

Your ability to heal and revive units gives you a major advantage over the AI, exploit it. Most of the time when an enemy unit is KO'ed it is dead for good. Your party on the other hand should be able to heal and revive units with at least one and preferably two different characters.

*Source: [W:435-467](#source-w)*

name: Chapter 2 — preparation and battle index
text:
### Chapter 2 — preparation and battle index

**ID:** `campaign-chapter-2` · **Type:** chapter · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 2

**Provenance:** [W:1966-2023](#source-w)


#### Chapter guidance

##### Control + F

Dorter Trade City [2.2a] Araguay Woods [2.2b] Zirekile Falls [2.2c] Zaland Fort City [2.2d] Bariaus Hill [2.2e] Zigolis Swamp [2.2f] Goug Machine City [2.2g] Bariaus Valley [2.2h] Golgorand Execution Site [2.2i] Lionel Castle [2.2j] Queklain [2.2k]

||| Strategies |||

/ Buff Your Party \

Casting spells like Haste, Protect, Shell, Reraise, and other support magic will make it much harder for the enemy to kill you. Haste in particular gives your party a huge advantage.

/ Classes Greatly Alter Ability Strength \

I cannot stress this next bit of information enough: which class has the abilities equips makes a huge difference. Punch Arts is very weak unless it is in another class with good PA and Martial Arts. Summon Magic is much more powerful on a Wizard than any other class since it is MA based and Wizards have the best MA in the game. Yin-Yang Magic is good on almost any unit as long as they have high faith, etc. Try to understand what stats make determine the power of each skillset and tailor your units accordingly. The Classes and Abilities section has useful information for that purpose. ---

Between battles

Save your game after Fort Zeakden. Agrias will sometimes start with the ability Hi-Potion learned in case you want to reset until she knows it.

At Bars, Propositions are now available. Proposition allow you to send some of your excess units on trips for the chance to gain JP, gold, and rare treasures (which cannot be used but do offer a description in the Brave Story section).

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Add Rad, Alicia, and Lavian into your party. You will not use them, but you can always sell their equipment. Unequip all their stuff. Equip Item secondary and Battle Boots on Agrias and Gafgarion. ---

*Source: [W:1966-2023](#source-w)*

name: Chapter 3 — preparation and battle index
text:
### Chapter 3 — preparation and battle index

**ID:** `campaign-chapter-3` · **Type:** chapter · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 3

**Provenance:** [W:2936-3008](#source-w)


#### Chapter guidance

##### Control + F

Goland Coal City [2.3a] Lesalia Castle [2.3b] Underground Basement 2F [2.3c] Underground Basement 3F [2.3d] Underground Basement 1F [2.3e] Grog Hill [2.3f] Yardow Fort City [2.3g] Yugou Woods [2.3h] Riovanes Castle [2.3i] Velius [2.3j] Riovanes Castle Rooftop [2.3k]

||| Strategies |||

/ Equipment with Stat Enhancements \

Notice how the Wizard Robe adds 2 MA to your unit? No other Robe does that. The Wizard Robe is arguably the best Robe in the game and is available in Chapter Two. Sure other equipment may have more HP or MP but PA, MA, and Speed are much more important. The Black Hood costs more than the Green Beret and offers more HP but it would be foolish to unequip your Green Beret and lose that Speed Point. Pay attention to which equipment boosts which stats and tailor your units accordingly. Twist Headband and Power Sleeve are some of the best equipment in the game for Archers, Monks, and Ninjas.

/ Have a Balanced Attack \

There are three main ways of attacking the enemy: physical attack damage, magic attack damage, and status attacks. Try to have a balanced party that can attack the enemy in all three ways. Fighting an enemy with a lot of low Faith? Try Talk Skill, Elemental, or physical attacks. ---

New equips and Fur Shops are available in Chapter Three. Now if you Secret Hunt a monster you can buy poached items. Check out the Poaching Section for more details. Fur Shops can only be found in Trade Cities (e.g. "Dorter Trade City").

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Buy some more Hi-Potions so you have about 50 or so. Buy some more Balls if you need them and a few Flails. Equip a Brigadine on Ramza. Time for some leveling.

Equip gained JP Up on everyone who has it before going into the random battle. Make Annette and Laura Summoners. Turn Agrias into a Chemist, leave Zach as a Monk and make Ramza a Priest. Your goal for this battle is to get Annette and Laura enough JP for Moogle, Agrias enough JP for Auto Potion and Phoenix Down, Ramza 200 total JP and Zach enough JP for Chakra and Revive. Have everyone finish the battle at level 16. Have Ramza use Cheer Up as much as possible.

Teach Zach Chakra and Revive: Cross Helmet, Gold Armor, Battle Boots, Basic Skill, Auto Potion, Equip Armor, Move+1. Teach Ramza throw Hammer and make him a Ninja: Green Beret, Brigadine, Wizard Mantle, Guts, Auto Potion, Concentrate, Move+2. Teach Agrias Auto Potion. Agrias can become her base job, Holy Knight: best remaining equips, Battle Boots, Item, Auto Potion, Move+1. Teach Annette and Laura Mogri. Turn them into Wizards with Summon secondary: Thunder Rod (Annette)/ Ice Rod (Laura), Green Beret, Wizard Robe, Wizard Mantle, Auto Potion, Short Charge, and Move+1. Move to Goland Coal City for the next battle. ---

*Source: [W:2936-3008](#source-w)*

name: Chapter 4 — preparation and battle index
text:
### Chapter 4 — preparation and battle index

**ID:** `campaign-chapter-4` · **Type:** chapter · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 4

**Provenance:** [W:3909-3972](#source-w)


#### Chapter guidance

##### Control + F

Doguola Pass [2.4a] Bervenia Free City [2.4b] Finath River [2.4c] Zeltennia Castle [2.4d] Bed Desert [2.4e] Bethla Garrison [2.4f] Bethla Sluice Gate [2.4g] Germinas Peak [2.4h] Poeskas Lake [2.4i] Limberry Gates [2.4j] Elmdor [2.4k] Zalera [2.4l] Igros Castle [2.4m] Outside of Murond [2.4n] Inside of Murond [2.4o] Murond Chapel [2.4p] Underground Basement 4F [2.4q] Underground Basement 5F [2.4r] Murond Death City [2.4s] Lost Sacred Precincts [2.4t] Hashmalum [2.4u] Altima [2.4v]

||| Strategies |||

/ Exploit the AI \

The AI may look impressive at times but it is fairly predictable and has some major oversights. The AI will almost never attack a unit with Death Sentence on it. However equipment like Judo Outfits, Chameleon Robes, and Angel Rings keep Death Sentence from killing you. A unit with a Judo Outfit and Death Sentence on it is basically invincible for two turns. The AI also follows a basic movement pattern. The AI will usually try to stay movement range panels away from you. You can use this knowledge to plan jumps or lay spells on where you think the AI will move to and then watch them move into an area and receive heavy damage. ---

Ramza gets the ability SCREAM at the start of Chapter Four. It takes 500 JP to learn but it is very much worth it. One Scream raises Speed, Brave, PA, and MA. Think about that.

There is some new equipment available. Angel Ring provides one Reraise per battle, Earth Clothes strengthen Earth attacks (Titan, Earth Slash) and absorb Earth. Ice Brand is one of the best swords. Ice damage, powerful, and sometimes deals Ice 2 as a bonus. Morning Star provides a 16 WP throw. For a 10 Speed Ninja, that is 160 damage a throw.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Buy a Platina Shield for Agrias. Buy enough X-Potions os that you have around 20 or so. Unequip the Bracer from Ramza and give it to Agrias. Buy a pair of Sprint Shoes for Ramza. Teach Ramza Scream, arguably the best ability in the game. Go to Doguola Pass.

*Source: [W:3909-3972](#source-w)*

name: Orbonne Monastery — prologue and controls
text:
### Orbonne Monastery — prologue and controls

**ID:** `campaign-prologue` · **Type:** Campaign · **Section:** Campaign / Prologue

**Provenance:** [W:348-426](#source-w)


#### Orientation

The story begins with a historian talking about the past; a past you are about to live. He tells of a tale well known in this world of Ivalice but hints that there is more to this story. A young man named Ramza Beoulve is the true hero...

This Walkthrough has two sections for each battle. The first part is more general. It tell you which enemies you will fight, what to look out for, and what skills to use. The second part is much more detailed. In the 'Guided route — Overated' part I tell you how to make your party and what to do in battles to beat the game. If you intend on the following the Guided route — Overated section, choose January 1st as your birthday.

At the beginning of every Chapter I will explain a few basic strategies that can be used in any battle. In addition to what I tell you for each specific battle try to keep these general strategies in mind.

After picking a name for the hero, you are prompted to chose a birth date. The date you choose will determine your Zodiac symbol. Almost every battle action can be strengthened or weakened by Zodiac Combatibility. Some symbols are more popular than others because they give you certain compatibilities with different enemies, but any symbol can beat the game. See the Zodiac Compatibility section for more details.

##### Orbonne Monastery

Things to Learn... 1.) How to tell the movement range of units 2.) What the AT does and how it works 3.) Attacking from the side and back leads to a higher % of success

The hero Ramza is a mercenary defending a princess. This battle is very easy and almost impossible to lose (I once got a draw but that is another story). Take the time to familiarize yourself with the controls:

X - cancel Circle - confirm Triangle - bring up Menu Square - highlight the teams and allow you to move the camera L1 - rotate camera left R1 - rotate camera right L2 - zoom camera in or out R2 - tilt camera up or down Select - gives helpful description

The first thing you should do is hit X. Now you will be free to move the cursor around the battle field. Place the cursor over someone's head and hit X. The blue is how far the unit can move. Press Triangle to bring up the Menu.

##### Menu

AT - Active Turn list. This list shows in what order the units in battle will go in and when charged actions will resolve. Enemies are listed in red.

Unit List - List of units that allows you to more easily see their equipment and abilities.

Option - Brings up an option menu. Worth looking at after you get a few battles of experience.

The AT is a very useful list. Check it often to plan your up coming attacks. Spend the rest of the battle doing what you want. This is like an exhibition battle where you can familiarize yourself with the various menus, like the command menu:

##### Command Menu

Move - Moves the unit.

Act - Select which action to perform and then on whom to use it on.

Wait - Conserve CT. A Move and Act uses 100 CT, a Move or Act uses 80 CT and Wait uses 60 CT.

Status - Examine unit equips and abilities.

Auto Battle - Set a unit to one of the various Auto-battle options.

*Source: [W:348-426](#source-w)*

name: Gariland
text:
### Gariland

**ID:** `battle-2-1a` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1a

**Provenance:** [W:468-687](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) When an enemy loses all HP it collapses. When the counter reaches 0 it permanently dies.
2. ) When the battle has been decided, have units not working on killing the
remaining enemies beat on each other (to get JP and experience).

##### Controls for Choosing Your Party

Circle - Place/Remove Unit Square - Brings up unit Status menu Triangle - Put cursor over an enemy and hit Triangle to Bring the unit's description to the top of the screen. R1 - Cycle through the units L1 - Cycle through the units Start - Begin the battle Select - Help

There is not much to be concerned with in this battle. The enemy consists of four Squires and a Chemist. While the Chemist can be annoying, you outnumber the enemy six to five and Delita and Ramza are stronger than the average Squire. Use Potions and Wish to replenish your health. Concentrate your attacks on ganging up and killing units--the enemy has no way to revive them-- while keeping your units within range so they can be healed.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

The first battle puts you in command of the standard five units. Ramza is mandatory in all story battles but the rest of the party is yours to choose. Pick wisely as these units will become the backbone of your army. Take the Females with the two highest Faiths, a Male with the highest Brave and a Chemist. Place them such:

Starting Grid:

```text
    X
XXXXX
XX
```

Place Your Units:

```text
    X
XXCFR
FM
```

F - Female Units C - Chemist M - Male Unit R - Ramza

In my case, the two female units happened to be Squires who have one additional movement range then Chemists. The Female and Male units on the left will travel together and go forward, up the house and double team the Squire marked 'U' on the map. Move both the Male and Female unit as far up onto the roof of the house as you can and attack the U on your first turn if you can.

Have Ramza attack the 'S' Squire who just attacked Delita. Move the other Female Unit behind Ramza and wait, facing west. Move the Chemist to the left of the second Female Unit and heal Delita with a Potion. Hopefully on Delita's next turn he will kill a Squire.

With your next round of attacks, focus on killing the U Squire on the house with the two nearby units. If the S Squire did not die, take its back with your Female unit and attack. By now the battle should be well within hand. Ramza and Delita will combine to finish off the S enemy and your Chemist should heal the most damaged unit (probably the Male Unit). With your third round of attacks, finish off the U Squire, heal your most hurt unit with the Chemist and have Ramza and the Female Unit either retreat (if hurt) or work on dispatching another unit. By now you have the enemy outnumbered six to three. I led you to the water hole, now drink. ---

Between battles

Ah, the world map. Hit Triangle to bring up the menu and go to the Data option to save your game. The Brave Story lets you look at character bios and review some tasks that you have done. The Formation Menu lets you outfit your units, teach and equip new abilities on them, and change jobs.

Most blue circles on the map are towns. In town you can buy items and equipment from shops, check the bar for the latest rumors or go to the soldier office to hire a new unit. Different towns sell different equipment.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

The two Female Units with the best Faith and the male with the best Brave are the only generic units you need to concern yourself with outfitting. To make things easier, I will call the male unit Zach and the female units Annette and Laura. Correspond these names to the units that you choose.

Go to the Formation Menu and unequip everything from the units you will not be using. Then go to the Order Unit option and order them by HP. Turn Annette and Laura into Chemists and have Ramza, Delita and Zach be Squires. If Ramza has over 200 JP, teach him Gained JP Up and equip it as a Support. Give Zach, Ramza and Delita Item secondary and the girls Basic Skill secondary. Make sure all of them have the Potion ability learned and have Ramza and one of the Chemist learn Phoenix Down.

Go to the shop and buy about 15 or so Potions. Make sure all your Squires have a Broad Sword equipped and Annette has the Mythril Knife equipped. Unequip Battle Boots from Ramza and give them to Annette. Go to Mandalia Plains to start your battle.

*Source: [W:468-687](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Gariland](#map-gariland)

name: Mandalia Plains
text:
### Mandalia Plains

**ID:** `battle-2-1b` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1b

**Provenance:** [W:688-839](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to learn

1.) Your healing abilities give you a huge advantage over the enemy 2.) Move hurt units out of enemy range

##### Objective

This battle begins with a question: choose to do you duty and destroy the Death Corps or save the man who is under attack. Choosing "1. Our duty is to destroy the Death Corps." will give you 10 additional Brave for the battle and 2 permanent Brave points. That choice would sort of go against the spirit of what your father told you to do on his deathbed though. If you choose "2. Saving him is our priority." and the man dies then you will lose the battle.

##### Enemy Party

The enemy consists of four Squires, a Thief and a Red Panther. Beware of attacking the Panther, as all monster have innate Counter. If he survives your attack he will Counter Brave % of the time with an attack of his own. The Panther also has the Poison Nail skill that can inflict Poison on your units. The Thief is slightly stronger than the rest of the enemy units but usually lacks any decent Steal Skills. The enemy possesses no healing.

This battle is very easy. Focus on eliminating targets when they present themselves, heal frequently and move damaged units out of enemy range until they can be healed.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Have all your units have Item as a secondary and you should have no problem with this battle.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: X XXX X X X

Place Your Units: Z LXX A R X

A - Annette L - Laura Z - Zach R - Ramza

This battle is very easy. The only bit of strategy I can offer you is to place Annette as recommended and give her Battle Boots. That allows her to heal Algus on her first turn. Play the battle conservatively and you should have no problem. Have the Chemist heal anyone who is hurt on their turns. ---

Between battles

Save your game and move Ramza to Igros Castle.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

If Delita has enough Squire JP, 200, learn Move +1 and equip it. Change him into a Knight. Give Algus Item secondary. If Zach, Laura, or Annette have 200 Squire JP teach, equip Gained JP up. Zach, Ramza, and Algus are still Squires; Delita is a Knight and Annette and Laura are Chemists.

Time to outfit this group. Go to the store and buy enough Potions so that you have around 25. Buy Delita a Long Sword, a Escutcheon, a Bronze Helmet, and a Linen Cuirass. Buy Ramza and Zach Long Swords. Sell some of your unused stuff so that you can buy a pair of Battle Boots for Delita. Give Zach, Ramza and Delita your three pairs of Battle Boots (remove Algus's pair).

Move your party to Gariland Magic City. There is a 50% chance or so that passing over a green dot, in this case Mandalia Plains, will give you a random battle. If you get the battle, fighting it should not be that hard and will give you some helpful JP and experience. If you do not want to do the battle do a soft reset.

At Gariland Magic City, sell your unused equipment and your Holy Water. Buy Feather Hats for Ramza, Zach, Laura and Annette and Leather Outfits for Laura and Annette. Go to Sweegy Woods for the next battle. ---

*Source: [W:688-839](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Mandalia Plains](#map-mandalia-plains)

name: Sweegy Woods
text:
### Sweegy Woods

**ID:** `battle-2-1c` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1c

**Provenance:** [W:840-1016](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) Monsters can have good front evade (C-EV) but have no side or back evade. 2.) If one of your guest loses all their HP, they cannot die permanently.

##### Objective

Defeat All Enemies

##### Battle Difficulty

Easy

##### Enemy Party

~~ Two Bombs ~~ 3 Move 3 Jump 10% C Ev Innate: Float, Cannot Enter Water, Absorb Fire, Half Ice, Weak to Water

Slow, poor movement range and are weak to water elemental. Beware, if damaged down to low levels the can use Self Destruct, an area explosion that damages units by HP minus HP lost.

~~ Two Goblins ~~ 3 Move 3 Jump 18% C Ev - Innate: Weak to Ice

Slow and not very strong. Have Tackle and Eye Gouge (inflicts darkness). Darkness is not a troublesome status in this battle because all it does is double the evade of targets, so side and back attacks on monsters are still 100%.

~~ Black Goblin ~~ 3 Move 3 Jump 20% C Ev - Innate: Weak to Ice

Slow and poor movement range. Has the Turn Punch ability that can hit more than one target (and up to four). Turn Punch: X XGX X G - Black Goblin X - Squares Goblin can hit with one Turn Punch

~~ Red Panther ~~ 4 Move 4 Jump 23% C Ev - Innate: Ignore Height, Cannot Enter Water

Good Mobility and decent speed. Can use Poison Nail to inflict units with poison.

##### Be Wary of...

The Bombs Self Destruct technique. A hurt Bomb can explode and deal damage equal to the amount that it lost in a wide area. A 50 HP bomb that has only 5 HP left can self destruct and hurt all nearby units for 45 damage each.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Bring a some people with Potion and Phoenix Down learned and you should have no problem with this battle. Goblins are weak to Ice.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXX XXXXX XXX

Place Your Units: XXX XALXX ZRX

Z - Zach, R - Ramza, L - Laura, A - Annette

Move Ramza four squares forward and attack the Black Goblin. Move Zach five squares forward and attack the side of the Black Goblin. If Ramza's attack hit then the Black Goblin is dead by now. If the Goblin countered on Ramza's or Zach's attacks have Laura heal them. If not have her attack Delita's back and have Annette move forward three spaces and heal Delita.

On Ramza's second turn finish off the Black Goblin or take the Red Panther's back and attack it. Have Zach attack the Red Panther and have Laura heal Zach. Have Annette move forward three squares and kill the panther. So now it is four monsters to the six of you guys. Kill the Bomb on your next turn and Algus will probably be overwhelmed by now. Do not worry though because when guests collapse, they can not die permanently. Heal your damage when you get hurt and wipe out the rest of the monsters. ---

Put your cursor on Sweegy Woods and hit select. That's as close to a moogle as you will find in this game. What happened to the moogles? As MalcolmMasher once said those Red Panthers don't like water yet they still hang around the swamp...

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Teach Delita (if he hasn't learned it by now) and Algus Move +1 and equip those abilities. Teach Ramza Yell. Make sure both Annette and Laura have Gained JP Up. Turn Annette into a Wizard with Item secondary and give her Ramza's Battle Boots. Have her learn Bolt.

By now you might be wondering, hey Overated what's with all the pussy jobs? Why can't everyone be a Wizard/Knight/Monk etc? Well some of the most useful abilities are available early on. Some would argue that Auto Potion, the Chemist reaction ability, is the best in the game. Patience Grasshopper, you will one day become powerful. Maybe even a Ninja awaits you... ---

*Source: [W:840-1016](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Sweegy Woods](#map-sweegy-woods)

name: Dorter Trade City
text:
### Dorter Trade City

**ID:** `battle-2-1d` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1d

**Provenance:** [W:1017-1202](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) You can check the AT to see when and where spells are going to resolve 2.) Before selecting a spell or other charged action, hit right to see where in the AT it will resolve

##### Objective

Defeat All Enemies

##### Battle Difficulty

Average

##### Enemy Party

The enemy consists of a Knight, two Wizards and three Archers. This is generally regarded as the first challenging battle.

Male Knight - A strong fighter with evade. Sometimes has Item as a secondary and deals strong physical attacks.

Two Male Wizards - Very annoying. These guys are your biggest threats. Bolt is strengthened by the rain.

Three Male Archers - The highest Archer can attack you from the beginning of the battle. For some reason Delita and Algus always have a personal grudge against this guy and like to run up to this Archer and attack him. On the plus side one of the Archers forgot his bow.

##### Be Wary of...

The Wizards. Bolt is strengthened in this rain and Wizards are very powerful early in the game.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Bring at least one person who knows Phoenix Down and a few who know Potion. Healing is a necessity as you will be taking damage before you even get a chance to move.

Have a Wizard of your own with Bolt so you can deal some heavy damage to the enemy. Beware of the enemy Wizards and try to Bolt them before they Bolt you. Try to keep your units separated so that Bolt will not fry more than one of them. Send a unit with good movement or a ranged attack to finish off the high Archer so that Delita and Algus can get back into the other part of the battle.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXXX XXXX

Place Your Units: XXXXZ XAXL

L - Laura, A - Annette, Z - Zach It doesn't matter where you place Ramza as he will always start in the same position.

Annette is going to earn her keep this battle. Have Laura heal whoever the enemy Archer targeted and move one square forward. Move Annette three spaces forward and if she can Charge Bolt on the Knight and Wizard. If she cannot just hit the Knight with Bolt. Bolt has an area affect so you can target the panel next to him and still hit him. Before hitting Circle and selecting Bolt, hit right to see where in the AT Bolt will resolve. Move Zach as far up the hill as you can and wait. Have Ramza Yell at Annette and wait.

Have Zach take the highest Archer's side and Dash him. Dash may do less damage than a normal attack but has a 50% chance of knocking said Archer off the cliff, thus doing more damage. Have Ramza Yell Annette up again and wait. Now it's Annette's turn. She will have some sort of spell charged on her. Unless you have horrible luck (best compatability with the enemy Wizard), Annette will survive the spell. Have Annette charge Bolt on the Wizard and Knight (killing them both) and have her move two spaces forward to the seven height piece. Move Laura one square forward and one right and heal Annette with a Potion.

Move Annette back one space and one to the right and have her wait. If the Knight survived the two Bolt spells, have Ramza finish him off with his next turn. If the Knight is already dead Yell at Annette. If the Archer was knocked off the hill, move Zach down the hill. If not attack the Archer again. Laura should heal the most damaged unit and wait. Now it's Annette's turn. Move and target the last enemy Wizard with Bolt, thus killing him. The battle is practically over by now as the most serious enemy targets have been eliminated. Wipe up the rest of those Death Corps scum. ---

Between battles

Restock in Dorter Trade City before moving onto Sand Rat Cellar.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Teach Ramza and Zach Move +1 and equip it. Teach Laura Protect and equip White Magic as a secondary. Change Ramza into a Chemist and give him Guts as a secondary. Equip a Linen Robe on Annette and an Iron Sword on Zach.

At the store, buy enough Potions to give you around 25. Buy a Leather Outfit for Zach and Battle Boots for Ramza and Laura. Buy a Feather Hat and a Leather Outfit for Algus and a Rod for Laura. Time for some Sand R-a-a-a-ts. ---

*Source: [W:1017-1202](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Dorter Trade City](#map-dorter-trade-city)

name: Sand Rat Cellar
text:
### Sand Rat Cellar

**ID:** `battle-2-1e` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1e

**Provenance:** [W:1203-1393](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) The game will often split up your squad at the beginning of battle.

##### Objective

Defeat All Enemies

##### Battle Difficulty

Easy

##### Enemy Party

One Male Archer - His shots can arc over his own units and the awkward terrain to hit your units from unexpected places.

Two Male Monks - The only skill they are likely to know is Spin Fist, which allows them to attack all the panels adjacent to them in one attack. To calculate their fist damage it is [PA*Brave/100], truncate after the decimal point, then take that number and multiply it by PA. For example if they have 10 PA and 55 Brave: [10*.55]= [5.5] (truncate) = 5 5*10 = 50 damage per punch

Three Male Knights - They have shields so even from the side they can evade attacks.

##### Be Wary of...

Often an enemy or two will have Item as a secondary. Check for which units have it and try to eliminate these guys first so they cannot heal their side.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Wizards are very good for this battle. They can stay outside of the house and target spells on the units inside of it. Protect (White Magic) is a good spell to use too. It lessens physical damage to two-thirds of normal damage and in this battle all the enemy can inflict is physical damage.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: 1st Squad XXX X XXX

2nd Squad XXXX XXX

Place Your Units: 1st Squad ARX X XXX

A - Annette, R - Ramza

2nd Squad XXXX ZLX

Z - Zach, L - Laura

This play by play will be pretty accurate but realize that the enemy randomly has Item secondary and this will effect what happens. Have Ramza Yell Annette and wait. Move Annette three units forward and one right and target the closest Monk with Bolt. Make Laura move forwards two squares and two squares to the left and charge Protect on her. Move Zach into the effect area of Protect and have him block the doorway. If a Knight is in front of you attack him.

Move Ramza next to Annette and Yell at her. Move Annette onto the square between the tree and house and target an area where you can hit the most units. If Protect did not hit Zach, he'll probably be dead. Revive him with Laura's Phoenix Down and have her wait. Have Zach Potion himself and wait.

Move Annette to the square where she can deal the most damage and have her cast Bolt. This will probably kill two or three units, thus putting you in the driver seat. This battle is essentially over when that Bolt resolves. Annette + Yell = ownage. ---

Between battles

Head back to Igros Castle to continue the story.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

It is time to do a random battle and some minor leveling. Turn Annette into a Chemist with Black Magic secondary. That will mean Annette, Laura and Ramza are Chemists and Zach is a Squire. Turn a fifth generic unit into a Chemist and give him Algus's equipment.

At the store buy enough Potions so that you have about 30. Buy two Ice Rods, an Oak Staff, Red Hoods for Laura and Annette and a Leather Vest for Ramza. Run into a random battle at Sweegy or Mandalia. Kill all the monsters except for one and the have your units attack and heal each other until Annette, Laura and Ramza enough JP to learn Auto Potion and get Zach enough JP for Accumulate. To check how much JP a unit has go to Status, hit circle, and hit circle again to see the JP menu.

After the battle teach Ramza, Annette, and Laura Auto Potion and Equip it. Turn Annette and Laura into Wizards. Give them both Item secondary. Teach Annette Ice 2 and Laura Ice. Equip Ice Rod on both Annette and Laura and equip a Linen Robe on Annette. Make Ramza an Archer with Guts secondary. Change Zach to a Chemist and teach him Phoenix Down. Give him Basic Skill as a secondary. Reequip Algus's stuff that you gave to your generic for the random battle.

Go to Igros and buy Ramza a Bow Gun, a Buckler and a Small Mantle. Head to the Thieves Fort for the next battle. ---

*Source: [W:1203-1393](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Sand Rat Cellar](#map-sand-rat-cellar)

name: Thieves Fort
text:
### Thieves Fort

**ID:** `battle-2-1f` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1f

**Provenance:** [W:1394-1577](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) Many battles can be beaten by defeating a certain unit. 2.) Charm can be gotten rid of by dealing damage to a Charmed unit.

##### Objective

Defeat Miluda - You must deal fatal damage

##### Battle Difficulty

Average

##### Enemy Party

~~ Miluda ~~

Virgo - 68 Brave - 58 Faith - Level 7 4 Move - 3 Jump - 6 Speed - 10 C Ev - 16 S Ev - 5 W Ev - 6 PA - 4 MA

Battle Skill --- Weapon Guard Equip Change Move+1

Iron Sword Bronze Shield Iron Helmet Chain Mail Power Wrist

Vulnerable to Berserk, Sleep, Poison, Slow, Stop, Don't Move, Blind, Faith, Innocent, Silence, Confusion, Don't Act

A Knight with Weapon Guard, Miluda has good evade and high HP for this point in the game. She is aided by the two Priests who can heal her and Move +1. Try to attack her from her back as her evade will be significantly lower. Some of her equipment--Bronze Shield, Iron Helmet, Chain Mail, and Power Wrist-- is not available in stores yet but will be in the next Chapter. Steal Miluda's stuff if you want, but it is not worth the hassle.

Two Priests

These magi usually have Black Magic as a secondary. That makes them adept at both offensive attacks and defensive healing.

Three Thieves

Thieves are more of a speciality unit. Abilities like Steal and Secret Hunt are useful for getting equipment but they are not powerful fighters and can only equip Knives. They are more annoying than anything, especially when they have Steal Heart.

##### Be Wary of...

Miluda's excellent Knight range, her good evade and attack power. Keep your units spread or the Priests will punish you with Black Magic. The Thieves sometimes have Steal Heart but are not strong.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Wizards with elemental rods are very powerful at this point. A Wizard with an Ice Rod casting Ice gets a 33% or so damage bonus. Ramza's Yell is very powerful at this point. The rain here strenghthens Lightning elemental spells.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXX X X

Place Your Units: RXZX L A

The enemy and guests go first as usual. One of the Priests will probably charge a Black Magic Spell on Laura. Your goal in the first set of actions is to take out at least one Thief and that Priest. Have Annette charge an Ice 2 on a Thief (sometimes two) and not move. Laura goes next. Move her next to the Priest so that the spell will resolve on both Laura and the enemy Priest (hoist by your own petard eh?). If the Thief will survive Annette's spell, charge Ice on it. If it will not survive the spell, smack the Priest with your Rod. Zach will wait without doing anything. Have Ramza move forward three squares and one to the right.

Now it's 6 units to 4 in your favor. Zach gets to go again. Have him move forward one and right one square and heal Laura if she needs it. If she is unscathed, Accumulate and move forward one and right one. A Thief may Steal Heart Annette or Ariel. Should you get to control these treacherous wenches, launch an Ice 2 and Ice on Miluda. Remember to target multiple enemy units if possible. Next is Ramza. Try to undo the damage a Charmed unit has done--like killing a revived enemy unit--or hit the Charmed unit out of Charm or if no Charm has been performed shoot Miluda.

Zach can heal a hurt ally, knock a unit out of Charm or simply Accumulate. Annette's and Laura's next round of spells and a Ramza attack will finish off Miluda. ---

Between battles

Head back to Igros Castle, do the story stuff, and go to Gariland Magic City.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Equip an Iron Sword on Delita and give him Weapon Guard if he has enough JP for it. Go to the store and buy a Red Hood for Ramza and Zach. Buy a Leather Vest for Zach and Laura. Buy a few Phoenix Downs if you need them. Take a generic unit, make it a Chemist and give him some of your old equipment and Battle Boots. Teach him Phoenix Down if he does not know it.

*Source: [W:1394-1577](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Thieves Fort](#map-thieves-fort)

name: Lenalia Plateau
text:
### Lenalia Plateau

**ID:** `battle-2-1g` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1g

**Provenance:** [W:1578-1731](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) When you start a far distance from the enemy buff your stats before entering battle.

##### Objective

Defeat Miluda -- You must deal fatal damage

##### Enemy Party

~~ Miluda ~~

Virgo - 68 Brave - 58 Faith - Level 8 3 Move - 4 Jump - 6 Speed - 10 C Ev - 16 S Ev - 10/10 A Ev - 5 PA - 4 MA

Battle Skill Punch Art/Item/(there are probably some other possibilities) Counter Equip Change Jump+1

Mythril Sword Bronze Shield Barbuta Chain Mail Power Wrist

Vulnerable to Blind, Faith, Innocent, Silence, Berserk, Confusion, Don't Act, Sleep, Slow, Stop, Don't Move

Basically the same fighter as Thieves Fort Miluda but with slightly better equipment. Be wary of attacking her at close range because of her Counter Reaction Ability.

Two Wizards - Often have some level 2 spells. Powerful but Male so not as good as they could be.

Time Mage - An annoying unit. Will Haste his allies or cast Slow or Don't Move on you.

Two Knights - Female so not as strong as they could be but usually have some breaks.

##### Be Wary of

The enemy Wizards and Time Mage. The Time Mage can Haste allied units or Don't Move yours. These should be your major threats. Miluda has good evade and Defend so try to neutralize her help before focusing on her.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

It is still the time of Wizards. Wizards with elemental Rods are very effective at this time. Haste is also good.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXX XXX X XXX

Place Your Units: XGX ZXX X ARL

R - Ramza, A - Annette, L - Laura, Z - Zach, G - Generic Chemist

While this set up leaves Annette vulnerable to a charged spell, it will draw the enemy into a vulnerable position. Laura's action will depend on how the enemy lines up. Move her into a position where she can target as many units as possible with Ice and Annette can back her up and charge an Ice 2 spell and redirect the spell charged on her for some fatal damage. Have Ramza Yell Annette and wait. Move Annette so she can redirect a spell onto some enemies (if she has one charged on her) and have her charge a spell to finish off a few units. Have Zach and your generic Chemist wait. At the end of this set of actions you should have two to four enemy units killed.

Zach gets to go. Move and heal Annette if she needs it or move and Accumulate. Have the generic Chemist wait again. Only move and use this guy if someone is hurt or dead. After Delita goes, have Ramza finish kill a wounded target or, if none are available, Yell Laura. Annette gets another turn and later Laura. Have them charge spells to finish off the mages. If the mages are already dead, target Miluda. A few rounds of Ice or Ice 2 will end the battle. ---

*Source: [W:1578-1731](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Lenalia Plateau](#map-lenalia-plateau)

name: Fovoham Plains
text:
### Fovoham Plains

**ID:** `battle-2-1h` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1h

**Provenance:** [W:1732-1868](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Things to Learn

1.) Sword Skills are powerful

##### Objective

Defeat Wiegraf -- Hurt him for 80% of his total HP

##### Battle Difficulty

Hard

##### Enemy Party

~~ Wiegraf ~~

Virgo - 71 Brave - 64 Faith - Level 9 - White Knight 3 Move - 4 Jump - 6 Speed - 10 C Ev - 19 S Ev - 10/10 A Ev - 6 PA - 4 MA

Holy Sword Charge/ (there are probably some other possibilities) Counter Gained Jp Up Jump+1

Mythril Sword Round Shield Barbuta Chain Mail Small Mantle

Vulnerable to Don't Act, Poison, Slow, Stop, Don't Move, Blind, Faith, Innocent, Silence

He uses deadly sword skills. Not only do the deal heavy damage and target areas but they inflict additional status effects like Stop, Death Sentence and even Dead.

Boco the Chocobo - Not strong but he has great movement and Choco Cure. Him and Delita also seem to have a personal grudge.

Knight - She has some break skills but is not very strong and starts too far away from your party to be much of a factor.

Two Monks - Female Monks that are hindered by their femininity. They sometimes have Wave Fist which allows them to deal some long range damage. I have seen one of these wenches with Elemental once but that is rare.

##### Be Wary of...

It is weird how Wiegraf always travels with females. Anyway Wiegraf is the only threat in this battle but he is a major threat. He deal high damaging attacks with harsh status bonuses.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Wizards man, Wizards. Oracles are good too because they can inflict status effects that Wiegraf is vulnerable to. Weapon Break works well too. Breaking Wiegraf's sword keeps him from using any of his Sword Skills.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXXX XX X

Place Your Units: XXZAL XX R

Have Ramza Yell Annette and wait. Have Laura move and target Wiegraf with Ice. Have Annette move and target Wiegraf with Ice 2. Zach will hit Delita with a Potion and wait. That should be the battle. If Wiegraf evades one of the spell have Ramza fire shoot an arrow at him and Annette charge another spell on him and run away. ---

*Source: [W:1732-1868](#source-w)*


**Related:** [Fovoham Plains](#map-fovoham-plains)

name: Fort Zeakden
text:
### Fort Zeakden

**ID:** `battle-2-1i` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 1

**Search aliases:** 2.1i

**Provenance:** [W:1869-1958](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

Things to Learn 1.) Males have more PA than Females, Females have more MA than Males. 2.) Auto Potion is an excellent reaction ability.

** Defeat Algus before two of Algus's turns to maintain the Brave you got at Mandalia Plains. **

##### Objective

Defeat Algus -- You must deal fatal damage

##### Battle Difficulty

Average

##### Enemy Party

Algus - Weak attacker with a low damage bow that sometimes adds Darkness. He is strong defensively with high HP, a shield, Auto Potion and his bow allows him to hang back from the front line and still attack you. His secondary shifts and sometimes has Basic Skill, Item or Punch Art.

Two Wizards - These females are very strong. There female MA and Ice spells are strengthened by the cold weather. Approach these units with caution.

Three Knights - Male warriors. They are not most troublesome enemy but start far in front of the Wizards and will cut you down if you do not plan accordingly.

##### Be Wary of

The Wizards' spells. Ramza often has a high damage spell locked on him before he can move. If Ramza gets hit with such a spell try to redirect it onto an enemy. Notice that while the enemy usually does not have healing, Algus has Auto Potion and is capable of automatically restoring 30 HP when you damage him.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Ice and Shiva are strengthened in this level. Wizards with Ice and Ice Rods dominate this level. If you can not dispatch Algus quickly, be able to neutralize the powerful enemy Wizards with strong offensive attacks, Silence Song, Shell or Auto Potion.

text:
### Dorter Trade City II

**ID:** `battle-2-2a` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 2

**Search aliases:** 2.2a

**Provenance:** [W:2024-2116](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Objective

Defeat all enemies

##### Battle Difficulty

Easy

##### Enemy Party

Two Thieves - Not powerful but Steal Heart is annoying.

Two Archers - They have the advantage of height so they are able launch attacks on you from near the beginning of the battle. Female so not as strong as they could be.

Two Wizards - Have some level 2 spells. Keep your units spread apart to avoid excessive damage.

##### Be Wary of

Steal Heart. Keep your units from being too bunched and try to have your lower HP units hang back so Gaf and Agrias will soak up the damage. It would be very hard to have your party be wiped out by the enemy but they are capable of knocking out a unit or two.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Gafgarion and Agrias. Haste and Wizards make this battle very easy.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXXX X XX

Place Your Units: XZALX R XX

If Laura or Annette have been hit by Steal Heart, have Ramza knock them out of Charm. If not Yell Annette up and wait. Annette and Laura should be able to kill at least two of the enemy. Prioritize the Wizards if they move into range, but if the do not go for who is available. Have Zach wait and Accumulate the whole battle unless someone is very injured or dead. This battle was over before it began. ---

Between battles

Before moving to Araguay Woods to start the next battle, check out the new equipment.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Buy enough Potions so you have about 20 or so. Buy enough Hi-Potions so that you have around 15. Buy a pair of Spike Shoes. Buy two Oak Staffs. Go to the fitting room and buy Ramza a Headgear and a Leather Mantle. Equip Rad's Chain Vest. Turn Ramza into a Squire, Laura and Annette into Time Mages (Black Magic secondary) and leave Zach as a Chemist. Go into a random battle and level up enough to get Ramza enough JP for Cheer Up (it's a new Squire ability available only from Chapter 2 onwards), Zach enough for Auto Potion and Annette and Laura as much Time Mage JP as you can and Move+1 (spillover JP from Ramza's actions). Make sure that everyone reaches and is around level 8 by the end of the battle. Once you kill all but one enemy, a good leveling strategy is to have Ramza Yell, Zach Accumulate and heal himself and the mages attack Zach.

Teach Laura and Annette Move+1 and equip it. Turn them into Summoners. At Dorter Trade City buy Annette a Thunder Rod and a Silk Robe. Equip a Red Hood and Battle Boots on her. Give Laura an Ice Rod, Red Hood, Silk Robe and Battle Boots. Give them both Black Magic secondary. At the store sell of your Potions and buy some more Hi Potions. From now on when Auto Potion activates you will use a Hi-Potion and restore 70 HP.

Teach Ramza Cheer Up, change him into an Archer and give him Guts secondary. Cheer up is a great ability. It allows you to raise people brave by five per Cheer Up. For every four points you raise someone's Brave one point becomes permanent. Give Ramza a Bow Gun, Bronze Shield, Headgear, Chain Vest and Battle Boots. Turn Zach into a Knight. Teach him Auto Potion and equip it. Give him Basic Skill secondary. Have him equip the best available equipment and Battle Boots. He will only be a Knight long enough to get 200 JP so he can become a Monk. Move to Araguay Woods to start the next battle. ---

*Source: [W:2024-2116](#source-w)*

text:
### Zaland Fort City

**ID:** `battle-2-2d` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 2

**Search aliases:** 2.2d

**Provenance:** [W:2244-2345](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

Choose "1. Don't want to get involved." to make the objective defeat all enemies. Your Brave will go up 5, 1 permanent. Choose "2. We have to help him!" to make the objective save Mustadio. Your Brave will go up 10, 2 permanent.

I recommend choosing the first option. Mustadio will die a fair amount of the time no matter what you do. However Balbanes would probably choose the second option.

##### Objective

Defeat all enemies / Save Mustadio

##### Battle Difficulty

Average / Hard

##### Enemy Party

Two Knights - Male fighters that are hampered by their average Move and Jump and the terrain. Sometimes have secondaries like Elemental, Item or Basic Skill. Check to see if they have Elemental as that will make them a much bigger threat.

Two Archers - Female. Their attack power is lessened but they have the terrain advantage and our capable or raining arrows down upon you.

Two Wizards - Male units but sometimes have level 3 spells. They are the main threat and will often kill Mustadio before you have a chance to help him.

##### Be Wary of

The Wizards and their powerful spells, the Knights sometimes having Elemental, and Mustadio wanting to die.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

It is nice to have a 4 Jump Agrias (Spike Shoes). That will get her into the battle very quickly. Bring healing for Mustadio and Haste if you plan to save him.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXX XXXX

Place Your Units: LXXX AZRX

Choose "1. Don't want to get involved." Have Ramza Yell Annette and wait. Have Zach Accumulate and wait. Move Annette forward and have her summon a Ramuh on the Wizards. Have Laura back her up and charge a Shiva on any of the Wizards that might survive the Ramuh. Your goal is to kill the Wizards on your first set of actions.

If anyone is severely hurt, have Ramza Wish them better. If not Yell at Laura. Move Zach three spaces forward on top of the wall and Accumulate. Have Annette and Laura summon again and try to kill at least one more unit. The battle should be about over by this point. ---

Between battles

Check out the new equips before moving on to Bariaus Hill.

---

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

At Zaland Fort City, buy Zach an Adaman Vest, Annette a Triangle Hat and Ramza a Adaman Vest. Buy enough Hi-Potions so you have about 50 or so. Time to level up and learn some new abilities in a Random battle.

Turn Zach into a Knight. Unequip Auto Potion on him. Turn Annette and Laura into Time Mages (Summon secondary). Keep Ramza as a Thief. Go into a random battle and kill all the enemies except for one. Bring Boco into the battle too. Have Ramza Cheer Up until everyone's Brave is 100, have Zach Accumulate, have Annette and Laura beat up on Zach and have Boco heal any damage Zach receives with Choco Cure. The goal in this battle  is to get Ramza enough JP for Move+2, Annette and Laura enough JP for Short Charge and Zach enough JP for Equip Armor. Have everyone (except Boco, his level is unimportant) finish the battle at level 11.

Turn Ramza into a Knight (Guts Secondary) and teach and equip Move+2. Equip Battle Boots on him. Teach Zach Equip Armor and equip it. Change him into a Monk: Cross Helmet, Gold Armor and Battle Boots. Turn Annette into a Wizard (Summon secondary), teach and equip Short Charge and equip on her: Thunder Rod, Triangle Hat, Wizard Robe and Battle Boots. Do the same to Laura except equip on her an Ice Rod and Silk Robe. While you are at it equip Battle Boots on Agrias. ---

*Source: [W:2244-2345](#source-w)*

text:
### Bariaus Hill

**ID:** `battle-2-2e` · **Type:** battle · **Section:** Campaign / Chapter 2

**Search aliases:** 2.2e

**Provenance:** [W:2346-2439](#source-w)


#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Objective

Defeat All Enemies

##### Battle Difficulty

Hard

##### Enemy Party

Two Male Knights - Almost always have and use troublesome breaks. A hassle since some of your equipment, like the Cross Helm, cannot be bought at stores yet.

Two Male Archers - Given some decent Charge abilities and the terrain advantage. Good at dispatching the units the Summoners wound.

Two Female Summoners - Slow but they are very powerful. This is the first battle with Summoners so their 100%, wide range, summons might take you by surprise. The Summons they have can be targeted at a range of four panels away and have an Area of Effect of: X XXX XXXXX XXX X

Plan accordingly and try to hit them before they hit you.

##### Be Wary of

The enemy Summoners. With their limited MP it is unlikely for them to use more than two Summons but they are powerful.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Skills that can neutralize the Summoners that can be used from a range. Magic Break with a gun, Silence Song, Earth Slash, Summons and Black Magic (reinforced with a Wizard Robe, Triangle Hat and an Elemental Rod) can take care of those pesky Summoners. Shell and Magic Defense Up are nice to have as the lessen Summon damage by roughly two thirds.

If you change Agrias into a Knight and give her Holy Sword secondary then she will be able to use her sword techniques and deal additional damage.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXX XXXX XXXX

Place Your Units: XXXX XXXX ARZL

A - Annette, R - Ramza, Z - Zach, L - Laura

Have Zach Accumulate and wait. Laura will wait, Ramza will Yell Laura and wait and Annette will wait.

Make Laura move one square to her left and four squares forward. Target the closest Summoner with Shiva. Move Zach to the closest Knight and attack. Move Annette to a place where she can target the other Summoner with Ramuh. If Annette is hurt, move Ramza to her and Wish her some life. If she is not hurt, move and Yell her.

Laura and Annette can target two more Summons on their next turn which should finish off at least two more enemies. Zach can attack the best available target and Ramza can use Cheer Up for the rest of the battle. ---

Move to Lionel Castle. Before heading to the place after Lionel, you can go back to Zaland Fort City to purchase new equipment (I recommend the Green Beret). ---

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Go back to Zaland Fort City. Go to the fitting room and get a Green Beret, Wizard Robe and Wizard Mantle on Laura and Annette. Buy a Green Beret for Mustadio. Teach him Seal Evil if he does not already have it learned. Change Ramza into a Monk, with Battle Boots and Adaman Vest equipped. ---

*Source: [W:2346-2439](#source-w)*

Hard

Two Female Archers - Not strong but usually have Bows with a bonus like Poison Bow (add Poison) or Ice Bow. Have the terrain advantage.

The Summoners--keep your units from being too close, Steal Heart, Poison from the Archers.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Lightning Magic is strengthened in this level. Summons and Black Magic are very good for this stage. A neat strategy to fool around with is to equip Rubber Shoes on someone and Charge a Bolt 3 on them. The unit can advance on the enemy and attack them before the Bolt resolves, dealing damage to them and being defended by the Rubber Shoes.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: XXXXX XXXXX

Place Your Units: XXXXL XXZAB

L - Laura, Z - Zach, A - Annette, B - Boco, Ramza will always start in the same place

Move Annette four squares forward and charge Ramuh on the two Summoners. Move Zach onto Boco and Accumulate. Have Ramza Yell Annette and move him four squares to the right. Move Laura to a place where she can Summon a Shiva on a Thief or two.

Annette's Summon should kill the two Summoners and Laura's should wound or kill the Thieves. Have Annette finish of the Thieves and get Ramza enough JP (350 total) to unlock Geomancer, before finishing the battle. Add Mustadio to your team after the battle. ---

### Bariaus Valley

#### Battle plan, source-specific walkthrough and between-battle preparation

##### Objective

Save Agrias

##### Battle Difficulty

Hard

##### Enemy Party

Two Male Knights - Have some good Break Skills and will sometimes have good secondaries like Elemental or Item.

Two Female Archers - The one on top of the hill has a huge terrain advantage and can fire on a wide range of targets. To make things worse she usually has a Lightning Bow that adds a Bolt 2 to attacks 25% or so of the time.

Two Male Wizards - Will sometimes have level three spells. Bolt 3 in this rain is not fun to get hit by.

##### Be Wary of

The Wizards and the Archer on the hill.

##### Units to Have, Skills to Use

Bring healing for Agrias in the form of a good ranged healing unit with Wish, Mogri, Hi-Potion, or Cure. Bringing someone with some good protection spells like Protect, Shell, or Golem helps too. Agrias is a Cancer. Bolt spells are strengthened in the rain so Wizards and Summoners are good to bring. Yelling Agrias can make her even more lethal.

-=- Guided route — Overated -=-

Starting Grid: 1st Squad X XXX XXX

2nd Squad XX  X XX XXX X

Place Your Units: 1st Squad X XXX ZAR

2nd Squad XX  X XX BLX X

Z - Zach, A - Annette, R - Ramza, B - Boco, L - Laura

Ramza can Yell Annette and wait. Move Annette three spaces in front of Ramza and unleash a Ramuh on the Wizard and Knight. That should kill them both. Move Zach one square left and four squares forward. Have him Accumulate. Move Laura two spaces forward and target a Summon on the Archer and Wizard. When those two Summons resolve at last two and probably three or four of the enemy will be dead. Have Boco heal Laura if she needs it or kill an Archer or Wizard if they are charging something on her. While you can finish this battle on your next round of actions, get Ramza 200 total Geomancer JP first. Add Agrias to your party after the battle. You might have to get rid of a unit to add Agrias. Between battles
