name: FFT Online — historical fan project, not a current game feature
text:
### FFT Online — historical fan project, not a current game feature

**ID:** `fft-online` · **Type:** reference · **Section:** Challenges / Historical fan content

**Provenance:** [W:14596-14615](#source-w)


#### Source discussion

Starting in early 2004, some members of the GameFAQs and I started simulating FFT Versus battles by playing on a GameFAQs Message board.

http://boards.gamefaqs.com/gfaqs/gentopic.php?board=19482

It has a small following and so far is the best FFT Online versus simulation that has been thought up. If you are interested in joining, check out that board and leave your email address and someone will get back to you when the next tournament starts.

More important is the creation of a real time FFT Online game. Here I hope to post names of people who are interested in working on such a program, what code they like to use, etc. so that if someone wants to start such a program he has a group of people to contact for help. I will also post updates on the status of FFT Online projects as the time comes.

*Source: [W:14596-14615](#source-w)*

name: Scavenger Hunt — optional challenge rules
text:
### Scavenger Hunt — optional challenge rules

**ID:** `scavenger-hunt` · **Type:** reference · **Section:** Challenges / Scavenger Hunt

**Provenance:** [W:14055-14128](#source-w)


#### Source discussion

The rules are simple. Complete these challenging tasks to gain a higher ranking. Complete all of them and send me an email explaining how you did it and promising that you did do it and I will list you as a Master Scavenger Hunter. No GameSharks, save states or other cheating methods allowed.

$$$ $$$$$$$$$$$$ $$$ $$$ RANKINGS $$$ $$$ $$$$$$$$$$$$ $$$

1% - 25% of Tasks Completed: Gelwin

26% - 50% of Tasks Completed: Goltana

51% - 75% of Tasks Completed: Grevados

76% - 99% of Tasks Completed: Ovelia

100% of Tasks Completed: Master Scavenger Hunter

$$$ $$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$ $$$ $$$ MASTER SCAVENGER HUNTERS $$$ $$$ $$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$ $$$

So far no one has completed all of the tasks.

$$$ $$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$ $$$ $$$ SCAVENGER  HUNTS $$$ $$$ $$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$$ $$$

These can be completed in any order and with different play throughs.

1.) Have 19 units in your Formation Menu

2.) Kill 16 units in a single action

3.) Guard an enemy action with Finger Guard

4.) Realize the connection between the first four Rankings

5.) Kill Elmdor with his own Weapon

6.) Get an Excalibur in Chapter Two

7.) Defeat Adramelk without getting hurt or Petrified but still letting him resolve one successful action against you

8.) Complete this sequence: Jump in the air with Ramza, the enemy moves, and then Ramza lands on the enemy who just moved

9.) Defeat Queklain with just a Chemist with no secondary, reaction, support, or movement ability equipped

10.) Have an unit with 30 remaining HP fall from a height difference of over 10 and survive the fall

11.) Witness the enemy hurt itself and heal an ally (an enemy ally) in a single action

12.) Complete Bethla Sluice without reducing an enemy's HP to 0

13.) Steal every non-buyable item in the final battle series

14.) Beat Grog Hill's Rare battle with a Monk SCC team and only buyable equipment.

15.) Beat Bariaus Hill's Rare battle with a Mediator Ramza (only Mediator abilities and Monster Skill support if desired) and four monsters

16.) Watch Zalbag "Ruin" someone

*Source: [W:14055-14128](#source-w)*

name: Coverage audit and remaining knowledge gaps
text:
### Coverage audit and remaining knowledge gaps

**ID:** `verification-coverage` · **Type:** audit · **Section:** Verification / Audit


#### What completion means here

All six files were processed from their complete mounted text, not only the truncated chat previews. Their indexed battle, ability, class, equipment, script and numeric-table records were consolidated. Preservation checks below test extraction, not the truth of every claim. External research was performed after the initial structural draft and used selectively; it did not independently retest all game systems.

**Open gaps:** the main source never supplied a complete proposition schedule, many later story-map matrices, or all monster stat cells. Its END floor grid is incomplete. The additions improve dispatch guidance and supply six optional-battle briefs, but do not fill every absent tile, date or numerical range. Several legacy item descriptions are “????”; descriptive flavor text is left unknown rather than fabricated. Earliest individual sidequest triggers remain incompletely verified. Exact full-playthrough optimality and every original formula have not been independently tested.

Several search queries returned irrelevant results, and some GameFAQs/Caves of Narshe pages were blocked. Such results were not used as evidence. Accessible references corroborated edition boundaries, selected equipment properties, a conservative recruitment route and optional-battle guidance. These checks cannot certify a universally complete or error-free game encyclopedia.


#### Preservation and deduplication rules

A shared HP/MP profile is stored once and linked from every character/class/monster identity that uses the identical supplied rows. Missing numeric cells remain empty. Boss one-level tables are not extrapolated. Walkthrough monster tables and the standalone stats FAQ are not combined because their assumptions/ranges differ. Shared map blocks are stored once; new tactical remarks and alternate coordinate claims remain attached.

In-game dialogue can repeat intentionally; short repeated lines remain in scene order. Alternative source prose that offers a different interpretation or ranking is not treated as a factual duplicate. This preserves completeness at the cost of a small amount of meaningful contextual repetition.


#### Measured extraction checks

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| source files | 6 |
| source lines | 78,688 |
| source words | 336,882 |
| records | 2,198 |
| battle sections | 53 |
| indexed action abilities | 350 |
| bmg class records | 145 |
| hpmp entries | 189 |
| hpmp unique profiles | 140 |
| hpmp original rows | 16,346 |
| hpmp referenced rows | 16,346 |
| hpmp stored rows | 12,978 |
| walkthrough monster rows original | 4,752 |
| walkthrough monster rows stored | 4,752 |
| script scenes | 106 |
| same blocks removed | 65 |
| field discrepancies | 187 |
| web sources | 12 |

Numeric rows are counted before and after identity-to-profile deduplication; linked profile reuse is expanded for the referenced-row check. Row preservation is separate from factual validation.


#### Final preservation validation

Exact numeric-row multiset comparisons passed for all 16,346 supplied HP/MP rows and all 4,752 walkthrough monster-stat rows after shared-profile expansion. All 350 action boxes remain distinct records; all 1,424 nonempty effect/carrier text lines from their right-hand columns are retained. Markdown anchors and dashboard record links resolve. These checks test preservation and navigation, not independent correctness of the original game data.

name: Corrections, disagreements and reliability rules
text:
### Corrections, disagreements and reliability rules

**ID:** `verification-errata` · **Type:** errata · **Section:** Verification / Read first

**Provenance:** [M:3854-3874](#source-m); [M:1086-1089](#source-m); [I:380-381](#source-i); [W:1522-1525](#source-w); [J:821-825](#source-j); [J:1753-1756](#source-j); [M:416-432](#source-m); [I:215-215](#source-i); [W:12620-12639](#source-w); [I:1136-1149](#source-i); [T:1923-1926](#source-t); [I:488-492](#source-i)


#### Duplicate ability indices

The mechanics source reuses 09C for Split Punch / Lightning Stab, 10A for Choco Ball / Choco Meteor, and 14A for Stab Up / Sudden Cry. All six named records are kept separately; no corrected binary indices are invented.

**Evidence status:** 350 source ability boxes have 347 distinct reported indices. Stable IDs include a name suffix where necessary.

Source claim: [M:3854-3874](#source-m). Reference: [Action-ability record legend](#ability-legend).

*Source: [M:3854-3874](#source-m)*


#### Ninja Sword XA

Use [(PA + Sp) / 2] as XA. The multiplication sign in the source XA column conflicts with its own damage formula and Charge formula.

**Evidence status:** Internal consistency correction, not new binary testing.

Source claim: [M:1086-1089](#source-m). Reference: [Attack](#mechanics-2-1).

*Source: [M:1086-1089](#source-m)*


#### Stone Gun

Weapon Power is 16, not 8. The BMG value is independently corroborated by RPGClassics. Its Petrify property must be read with the BMG initial-status convention.

**Evidence status:** Source I value rejected; web corroboration E04.

Source claim: [I:380-381](#source-i). Reference: [Stone Gun](#item-49).

*Source: [I:380-381](#source-i)*


#### Element-strengthening equipment

Strengthening changes the relevant attack stat by trunc(XA × 5/4); it is not a universal 33% final-damage increase.

**Evidence status:** BMG exact algorithm supersedes walkthrough approximation.

Source claim: [W:1522-1525](#source-w). Reference: [The Elements](#mechanics-1-6).

*Source: [W:1522-1525](#source-w)*


#### Level Jump2

Horizontal range is 2 panels, not 3. Higher learned Jump abilities cover the lower ranges.

**Evidence status:** BMG 2.3 supplies exact range.

Source claim: [J:821-825](#source-j). Reference: [Level Jump2](#ability-direct-level-jump2).

*Source: [J:821-825](#source-j)*


#### Preach and Solution

Preach raises Faith; Solution lowers Faith. The jobs-guide closing comment reverses Solution.

**Evidence status:** Its own ability definitions agree with BMG.

Source claim: [J:1753-1756](#source-j). Reference: [Talk Skill](#mechanics-3-10).

*Source: [J:1753-1756](#source-j)*


#### Brave and Faith departure thresholds

Chicken occurs below 10 battle Brave. Permanent Brave ≤5 or Faith ≥94 causes ordinary recruits to leave; Ramza and Guests are exempt from departure.

**Evidence status:** Do not confuse Chicken with dismissal.

Source claim: [M:416-432](#source-m). Reference: [On Brave And Faith](#mechanics-6-10).

*Source: [M:416-432](#source-m)*


#### Excalipar

Not a confirmed obtainable FFT item in these catalogues. The name remains in the verification register as a rejected/unsubstantiated report, not equipment advice.

**Evidence status:** Absence is not proof of a universal negative; no invented item stats.

Source claim: [I:215-215](#source-i). Reference: [Excalipar — unsupported source report](#unverified-excalipar).

*Source: [I:215-215](#source-i)*


#### Recruitment timing

The main walkthrough starts its chain in Chapter 3; the external Cloud route places the full chain in Chapter 4 after Adramelk. Use that later checkpoint as a conservative sufficient route, not proof that every preliminary scene is impossible earlier.

**Evidence status:** E02 narrows a safe route; earliest per-event unlocks remain incompletely verified.

Source claim: [W:12620-12639](#source-w). Reference: [Secret characters — original recruitment route](#recruitment-chain).

*Source: [W:12620-12639](#source-w)*


#### Genji theft battle

The item list calls the Elmdor theft fight the first Limberry battle. The walkthrough separates the castle gate encounter from the interior Elmdor fight; plan the Genji/Masamune attempt for the interior encounter.

**Evidence status:** PSX-only advice; do not transfer to WotL.

Source claim: [I:1136-1149](#source-i). Reference: [Genji Armor](#item-b7).

*Source: [I:1136-1149](#source-i)*


#### Narrative reliability

Bracketed combat narration in the script is the transcriber’s account/dramatization, not a deterministic game event or battle mechanic. Spoken dialogue, choices and Brave Story text are preserved separately from gameplay authority.

**Evidence status:** Do not infer canonical deaths or mandatory moves from embellished battle descriptions.

Source claim: [T:1923-1926](#source-t).

*Source: [T:1923-1926](#source-t)*


#### Same-name rare equipment

Javelin and Escutcheon each have ordinary and rare versions. Hex IDs and numerical profiles distinguish them; do not merge solely on the displayed name.

**Evidence status:** Rare Javelin WP30; rare Escutcheon P75/M50 in BMG.

Source claim: [I:488-492](#source-i).

*Source: [I:488-492](#source-i)*

### Original guide links — historical references

**ID:** `legacy-links` · **Type:** reference · **Section:** Sources / Historical links

**Provenance:** [W:14137-14196](#source-w)


#### Source discussion

Aerostar's Battle Mechanics Guide http://www.fftactics.net/fftmech/fftmech52.txt The best FFT guide. It is filled with useful information.

Challenge Board http://boards.gamefaqs.com/gfaqs/gentopic.php?board=4694 The official board of all FFT challenges.

Goryus's Battle List http://db.gamefaqs.com/console/psx/file/final_fantasy_tactics_battle_list.txt A guide that has all the possibilities for random and story battles.

Neokamek's GameShark helper http://mysite.verizon.net/kamek/fftgs/ An excellent program for GS users.

ganonl's level-up, level-down program http://www.geocities.com/sigmahaven/lvlsimv0.9.zip An excellent program that simulates leveling up in one class, down in another and stat growth for various playable and non-playable classes.

FFT Realm Fansite http://www.fftrealm.com The best FFT fansite I have encountered. The have scans of all the maps. You can also pick up ganonl's level-up, level-down simulator program.

FFT Challenge Chat Channel chocobo.esper.net #fftchallenge A small but educated community.

Cave of Narshe Fansite http://www.cavesofnarshe.com/fft/ A slick looking fansite.

FFT General Board and Board FAQ http://boards.gamefaqs.com/gfaqs/gentopic.php?board=2000051 A board with intelligent FFT discussion and a useful board FAQ made by philsov.

Notti's Deep Dungeon Guide http://db.gamefaqs.com/console/psx/file/ final_fantasy_tactics_deep_dungeon_a.txt While I have not read this guide I hear many good things about it. Do not be fooled by its name, it covers more than the Deep Dungeon.

philsov's Challenge Guide http://db.gamefaqs.com/console/psx/file/final_fantasy_tactics_challenge.txt This has a list of various FFT challenges to try. These Challenges can be very fun and add replay value to FFT.

For now those are the most useful FFT links that I know about. Feel free to email me with some other links that you think should be included.
